corrections.critique: Strongest feature: Malpass precisely distinguishes standard Cantorian transfinite arithmetic, where the presupposed subtraction is unavailable, from other formalisms, then reconstructs each checkout through consistent relative complements, directly neutralizing the alleged contradiction and its metaphysical-impossibility inference. Principal limitation: Although exceptionally responsive, the excerpt only begins the relative-complement explanation, so the conclusion depends on accepting that formal consistency answers an argument framed as metaphysical absurdity rather than arithmetic inconsistency. Live burden: Pro must supply an independently warranted metaphysical principle showing why infinite remainders are impossible after the equivocal infinity-minus-infinity operation is removed. Locked score: 94 appropriately reflects outstanding coherence, precision, charity, and burden contact, while preserving evidential reservation about moving from consistent representation to metaphysical possibility.
